name: UE ↔ eNodeB (E-UTRAN air interface)
summary: The LTE radio interface between the UE and the eNodeB. Carries RRC signalling and user data; NAS messages to the MME ride transparently over it.

name: eNodeB ↔ MME (EPC control plane)
summary: Control-plane reference point carrying S1-AP (UE context, bearer setup, paging) and tunnelling NAS signalling between the eNodeB and the MME.

name: eNodeB ↔ Serving GW (EPC user plane)
summary: User-plane reference point that tunnels subscriber packets between the eNodeB and the S-GW per EPS bearer using GTP-U.

name: eNodeB ↔ eNodeB
summary: Direct interface between eNodeBs used for handover signalling and interference coordination; user data is forwarded over X2-U (GTP-U).

name: MME ↔ S4-SGSN
summary: Control-plane interface between MME and SGSN for inter-system (E-UTRAN ↔ UTRAN/GERAN) mobility and context transfer.

name: S4-SGSN ↔ Serving GW
summary: Connects a 2G/3G SGSN to the S-GW, giving the legacy packet core access to the EPC user-plane anchor.

name: Serving GW ↔ PDN GW (intra-PLMN)
summary: Core EPS bearer interface between S-GW and P-GW within the same network. The roaming (inter-PLMN) variant is S8.

name: Serving GW ↔ PDN GW (inter-PLMN / roaming)
summary: Inter-PLMN roaming variant of S5: VPLMN S-GW to HPLMN P-GW for home-routed traffic.

name: MME ↔ HSS (subscriber data & EPS auth)
summary: Diameter interface for location update, subscription-data download and EPS authentication-vector retrieval between MME and HSS. S6d is the SGSN equivalent.

name: S4-SGSN ↔ HSS
summary: SGSN-facing counterpart of S6a: same Diameter commands (ULR/AIR/...) for the 2G/3G packet core.

name: H-PCRF ↔ V-PCRF (roaming policy)
summary: Transfers policy and charging control between home and visited PCRFs for roaming scenarios.

name: MME ↔ MME
summary: Interface between MMEs for MME relocation and UE context transfer during handovers/TAU.

name: MME ↔ Serving GW
summary: Control interface where the MME drives the S-GW: create/modify/delete sessions and bearers, downlink data notifications.

name: UTRAN ↔ Serving GW (direct tunnel)
summary: Optional direct user-plane tunnel between a 3G RNC and the S-GW (one-tunnel / direct-tunnel architecture).

name: MME ↔ EIR (IMEI check)
summary: Lets the MME check a device's IMEI(SV) against the Equipment Identity Register (ECR/ECA). S13' is the SGSN variant.

name: PDN GW ↔ Packet Data Network
summary: The reference point between the P-GW and an external PDN (internet, IMS, corporate). 5G's equivalent is N6.

name: MME ↔ MSC/VLR (CS fallback / SMS)
summary: Connects the MME to the CS-domain MSC/VLR for circuit-switched fallback and SMS-over-SGs.

name: MME ↔ CBC (public warning)
summary: Carries warning messages (ETWS/CMAS public warning system) from the Cell Broadcast Centre to MMEs.

name: MME ↔ E-SMLC (positioning)
summary: Used for LTE positioning procedures between the MME and the Evolved Serving Mobile Location Centre.

name: MME ↔ GMLC (location services)
summary: GMLC requests UE location from the MME (PLR/PLA) and receives location reports (LRR/LRA).

name: GMLC ↔ HSS (LCS routing)
summary: GMLC queries the HSS for the serving MME/SGSN of a target UE before invoking SLg (RIR/RIA).

name: PCRF ↔ PCEF (PDN GW)
summary: Installs PCC rules and reports usage/events between the PCRF and the policy-enforcement function in the P-GW (CCR/CCA, RAR/RAA).

name: PCRF ↔ BBERF (Gxa/Gxc)
summary: Policy control toward a bearer-binding-and-event-reporting function in a serving gateway / trusted access (Gxa, Gxc).

name: PCRF ↔ TDF
summary: Controls a Traffic Detection Function for application detection and control under PCRF policy.

name: PDN GW (CTF) ↔ OCS (online charging)
summary: Real-time online charging / quota management between the P-GW and the Online Charging System (CCR/CCA).

name: PDN GW ↔ OFCS (offline charging)
summary: Carries offline charging records (CDRs) from the P-GW to the Offline Charging System.

name: AF (P-CSCF) ↔ PCRF
summary: Application Function provides session/media information (e.g. VoLTE codecs) to the PCRF so dynamic QoS can be installed (AAR/AAA, STR, ASR, RAR).

name: MME/SGSN ↔ SMS-GMSC (SMS over Diameter)
summary: Diameter-based SMS delivery between the serving node and the SMS centre (OFR/TFR/ALR), replacing the legacy MAP path.

name: SMS-GMSC ↔ HSS (SMS routing)
summary: Used by the SMS centre to retrieve SMS routing information from the HSS (SRR/SRA, RDR/RDA).

name: SCEF ↔ HSS (IoT exposure)
summary: Configures monitoring events, communication patterns and NIDD authorization for cellular-IoT devices (CIR/CIA, RIR/RIA, NIR/NIA).

name: MME ↔ SCEF (NIDD / monitoring)
summary: Carries Non-IP Data Delivery and monitoring-event reporting between the serving MME and the SCEF (CMR, ODR, TDR). T6b is the SGSN variant.

name: SGSN ↔ GGSN (intra-PLMN, legacy)
summary: Classic GPRS tunnelling interface between SGSN and GGSN within one network (Create/Update/Delete PDP Context). Gp is the inter-PLMN variant.

name: SGSN ↔ GGSN (inter-PLMN, roaming)
summary: Roaming variant of Gn across PLMN boundaries.

name: GGSN ↔ Packet Data Network
summary: Reference point between the GGSN and external packet data networks (the 3G analogue of SGi).

name: Trusted non-3GPP access ↔ PDN GW
summary: Connects trusted non-3GPP access (e.g. trusted WLAN / TWAG) to the P-GW for mobility anchoring.

name: ePDG ↔ PDN GW
summary: Anchors untrusted non-3GPP (WiFi-calling via ePDG) sessions to the P-GW.

name: UE ↔ PDN GW (DSMIPv6)
summary: Host-based mobility (Dual-Stack Mobile IPv6) directly between the UE and the P-GW.

name: UE ↔ ePDG
summary: The IPsec tunnel a UE sets up to the ePDG over untrusted access (e.g. WiFi calling).

name: ePDG ↔ 3GPP AAA
summary: Authentication/authorization and tunnel parameters for untrusted non-3GPP access (DER/DEA, AAR, STR, ASR).

name: Untrusted non-3GPP access ↔ 3GPP AAA
summary: Authenticates and authorizes the untrusted non-3GPP access network with the 3GPP AAA server.

name: Trusted non-3GPP access ↔ 3GPP AAA
summary: Authentication/authorization (EAP-AKA') for trusted non-3GPP access to the EPC.

name: 3GPP AAA ↔ HSS
summary: Retrieves authentication data and subscriber profile, and registers the AAA server, for non-3GPP access (MAR/MAA, SAR, PPR, RTR).

name: UE ↔ P-CSCF (IMS)
summary: The SIP signalling interface between the IMS UE and its Proxy-CSCF (registration, calls).

name: CSCF ↔ CSCF (IMS)
summary: SIP interface between CSCFs (P/I/S-CSCF) for routing IMS sessions.

name: S-CSCF ↔ Application Server (IMS)
summary: IP Multimedia Service Control: invokes application servers (e.g. TAS for VoLTE supplementary services) via initial filter criteria.

name: P-CSCF (IMS-ALG) ↔ IMS-AGW
summary: Lets the P-CSCF (IMS-ALG), as realized in an access SBC, control the IMS Access Gateway: gate/pinhole control, NAT traversal, media anchoring and transcoding for access-side bearers.

name: I/S-CSCF / BGCF ↔ IBCF
summary: SIP interface between the core CSCFs (or BGCF) and the IBCF, used to route sessions toward another IMS network through the interconnection border.

name: IBCF ↔ IBCF (II-NNI signalling)
summary: Inter-IMS network-to-network SIP signalling interface between the IBCFs of two interconnected operators. Izi carries the corresponding media.

name: TrGW ↔ TrGW (II-NNI media)
summary: Inter-IMS network-to-network media interface carrying RTP between the Transition Gateways of interconnected operators; the bearer counterpart of Ici.

name: IBCF ↔ TrGW
summary: Control interface by which the IBCF, as realized in an interconnection SBC, drives the Transition Gateway for media gating, NAPT and transcoding at the network border.

name: I/S-CSCF ↔ HSS (IMS)
summary: Registration, S-CSCF assignment, user-profile download and IMS authentication (UAR, SAR, LIR, MAR). Dx is the SLF-routed variant.

name: I/S-CSCF ↔ SLF (IMS)
summary: Used with a Subscription Locator Function to find the right HSS in multi-HSS deployments; carries the same Cx commands.

name: SIP AS ↔ HSS (IMS)
summary: Lets application servers read/write transparent and repository user data and subscribe to changes (UDR, PUR, SNR, PNR). Dh is the SLF variant.

name: SIP AS ↔ SLF (IMS)
summary: SLF-routed variant of Sh for locating the correct HSS.

name: CTF ↔ CDF (offline charging)
summary: Offline charging: network elements send accounting records to the Charging Data Function.

name: CTF ↔ OCS (online charging)
summary: Online charging for IMS/services using Diameter Credit-Control toward the OCS.

name: UE ↔ AMF
summary: Logical NAS signalling reference point between the UE and the AMF (registration, connection and mobility management); transported transparently over N2.

name: (R)AN ↔ AMF
summary: Control-plane reference point between the gNB/ng-eNB and the AMF (NG-AP: UE context, PDU session resource setup, paging).

name: (R)AN ↔ UPF
summary: User-plane tunnel carrying subscriber packets between the RAN and the UPF (5G equivalent of S1-U).

name: SMF ↔ UPF
summary: The SMF programs the UPF (packet detection, forwarding, QoS and usage-reporting rules) using PFCP — the CUPS control/user-plane split.

name: UPF ↔ Data Network (DN)
summary: Reference point between the UPF and an external data network (internet, IMS, edge). The 5G counterpart of EPC's SGi.

name: UPF ↔ UPF
summary: User-plane tunnel between two UPFs (e.g. I-UPF and anchor UPF, or home-routed roaming).

name: PCF ↔ AF
summary: Reference point letting an Application Function influence policy/traffic; realized over the Npcf service (5G analogue of Rx).

name: SMF ↔ PCF
summary: Session management policy control: SMF retrieves PCC rules from the PCF (5G analogue of Gx).

name: AMF ↔ UDM
summary: AMF retrieves access & mobility subscription data and registers with the UDM.

name: SMF ↔ UDM
summary: SMF retrieves session-management subscription data and registers the serving SMF with the UDM.

name: AMF ↔ SMF
summary: AMF requests PDU session create/update/release at the SMF; relays N1 SM and N2 SM containers.

name: AMF ↔ AUSF
summary: Primary authentication: AMF invokes the AUSF to run 5G-AKA / EAP-AKA'.

name: UDM ↔ AUSF
summary: AUSF obtains authentication vectors / generates authentication data from the UDM/ARPF.

name: AMF ↔ AMF
summary: AMF-to-AMF for UE context transfer during AMF relocation / mobility (5G analogue of S10).

name: AMF ↔ PCF
summary: Access and mobility policy control (AM policy, UE policy) between AMF and PCF.

name: SMF ↔ SMF
summary: SMF-to-SMF for home-routed roaming (H-SMF / V-SMF) and SMF relocation.

name: AMF ↔ 5G-EIR
summary: Equipment identity (PEI/IMEI) check against the 5G Equipment Identity Register (5G analogue of S13).

name: AMF ↔ NSSF
summary: Network slice selection: AMF asks the NSSF for the allowed/served NSSAI and target AMF set.

name: AMF ↔ MME (EPS interworking)
summary: Optional interface enabling seamless EPS ↔ 5GS handover with single-registration interworking between the AMF and MME.

name: SEPP ↔ SEPP (roaming)
summary: Secured inter-PLMN interface between Security Edge Protection Proxies for 5G roaming signalling.

name: NEF ↔ AF
summary: Northbound API exposure: the NEF exposes 5GC capabilities (monitoring, QoS, NIDD) to external Application Functions.

name: AMF service-based interface
summary: The AMF's service-based interface (communication, event-exposure, MT, location services) consumed by other NFs over the SBA bus.

name: SMF service-based interface
summary: The SMF's service-based interface for PDU session management and event exposure.

name: UDM service-based interface
summary: The UDM's service-based interface (subscriber data management, UE context management, authentication-data generation).

name: AUSF service-based interface
summary: The AUSF's service-based interface for UE authentication.

name: PCF service-based interface
summary: The PCF's service-based interface for AM/SM/UE policy control and policy authorization.

name: NRF service-based interface
summary: The NRF's service-based interface for NF registration, discovery and access-token (OAuth2) services.

name: NSSF service-based interface
summary: The NSSF's service-based interface for network slice selection.

name: UDR service-based interface
summary: The UDR's service-based interface used by UDM/PCF/NEF to read/write stored subscription, policy and exposure data.

name: NEF service-based interface
summary: The NEF's service-based interface exposing 5GC capabilities to AFs and storing data via the UDR.

name: CHF service-based interface
summary: The Charging Function's service-based interface for converged online/offline charging (Nchf_ConvergedCharging).
